title: Implement segments_left < hop_limit validation
description:
## Background
RFC 6554 and LICHEN spec/05-routing.md line 418 require:
"Segments Left MUST be strictly less than the Hop Limit available after any forwarding decrement."

## Current State
Test vectors created: test/vectors/source_route_hop_limit.json

## Implementation Gap
Neither Python nor Rust validates this constraint. Current code only checks segments_left <= addresses.len().

## Files to Update
- python/src/lichen/rpl/routing.py - SourceRoutingHeader validation
- rust/lichen-rpl/src/srh.rs - source route validation
- rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/util.rs - forwarding logic

## Test Vectors
- srh_segments_left_strictly_less_accept: Segments Left < Hop Limit (3 < 4) - MUST accept
- srh_segments_left_equal_reject: Segments Left = Hop Limit (3 = 3) - MUST reject
- srh_segments_left_greater_reject: Segments Left > Hop Limit (3 > 2) - MUST reject
